claims.text: Renamed To The Stars Inc. in 2022 after the departure of Elizondo, Mellon and Justice; subsequent output is entertainment.

edges.label: ADAM materials became the subject of a five-year Army CRADA
edges.note: On 17 October 2019 TTSA entered a CRADA with the US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command covering inertial mass reduction, metamaterials, quantum physics and beamed energy propulsion, with at least $750,000 in Army support and no public funding to the company.

a.label: ADAM Research Project (Acquisition and Data Analysis of Materials)

edges.label: Samples routed to laboratories founded by Puthoff
edges.note: TTSA partnered with Puthoff-founded laboratories to study the ADAM materials; Puthoff had already tested the same Howe samples privately, reporting in a 2012 letter that no anomalous outcome had been obtained.

a.label: CRADA between U.S. Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center and To The Stars Academy

edges.label: The chain goes dark inside a federal research agreement
edges.note: A CRADA is a records-generating instrument. Seven years after signature, no characterisation of the samples, no technical output and no Army statement of findings has been published. That silence is the darkest segment of the only documented private-to-federal materials transfer.

edges.label: Private, non-FOIA-able laboratory sitting between a government programme and a public company
edges.note: EarthTech has published no analytical results on the samples it has held, and as a private corporation is outside FOIA. Every documented chain that reaches it stops there.

edges.note: Puthoff co-founded TTSA with Tom DeLonge and Jim Semivan in 2017; the company's materials work was routed to laboratories he founded.

edges.label: Public technical voice: material 'not from any known existing military or commercial application'
edges.note: A former Skunk Works program director staking his name on the claim is what gave ADAM standing with an Army laboratory.

edges.label: Recruitment of a serving OUSD(I) official into a private disclosure vehicle
edges.note: DeLonge courted serving and retired officials from 2015-2017; the launch roster of 11 October 2017 is the product. The recruitment overlapped Elizondo's final year in government.
